scope: Independent static bytes/metadata/codegen review of eight wrappers, eleven resolver string sites, three guarded input paths, six exception-constructor calls; external Unity2022.3 documentation checked separately.

findings.finding: Null enumerator/Coroutine guards lead to original NullReferenceException(string) constructor calls using routine is null. Invalid host predicates lead to ArgumentException(string). These are packaged instruction/metadata observations, not API-documentation deductions.
Exact resolver argument strings are bound to direct calls to0x1b886ac and cached indirect tails. The resolved native engine function pointer implementations remain unknown.
The inspected StopCoroutine(string) wrapper has no managed null/input-host branch: its only conditional tests cached function pointer x2. Native validation is not inferred absent.

Unity2022.3 documents later-frame resumption, potentially different completion order, matching stop handle forms, per-behaviour StopAll and the differing effects of host destruction/GameObject deactivation versus disabling only the component. Those are reference contracts, not observed scheduler execution in this APK.

external_sources_checked.supports: Later-frame resumed work/completion ordering; destruction/GameObject-disable stop; component-disable alone does not stop.
Matching string/IEnumerator/Coroutine form on receiving behaviour; do not mix stop handle forms.
StopAll applies to the individual script/behaviour.

limits: No original engine scheduling, icall implementation, disposal/cancellation order, exception propagation or host lifecycle execution was observed.
Constructor calls and subsequent exception-boundary helper calls do not recover allocation, GC, stack unwinding or helper semantics.
Inspection stops use next metadata start and do not establish complete/noncontiguous bodies or exception-region coverage.
The producer provides version-specific pair hashes and selected opcode guards. This audit corroborates its current artifact; it is not a universal coroutine engine implementation.
No repeat of the already-green eight unit tests; review added independent raw decoding, metadata/codegen, listing/provenance and official-reference checks.
